svg.title: Melder ownership and lifetime map
svg.desc: Aetheric frames contain frame-wide unique objects and root conduits. Conduits own scoped objects, lineages may share objects with child conduits, spell spaces own request-local objects, and many creates a fresh object per meld. Cleanup moves from narrow scopes toward broad owners.

narrow scopes before owners
newest creations first
